theme_archetype: LIGHT LUXURY — Elegant · Minimal · Timeless · Editorial
status: LOCKED v2 (user-approved 2026-06). Light theme is the permanent visual identity. Dark mode is NOT used.

usage_rules: Deep Emerald (#0F3D3E) is the PRIMARY accent — buttons, active states, links, icons.
Champagne Gold (#C9A227) is a SECONDARY accent — use sparingly (thin rules, small marks, hairline dividers). Never as a large fill.
Backgrounds are white / #F8F8F6 only. No dark sections.

headings.description: Editorial luxury serif for all display/headings. Elegant, high-contrast.

body.description: Clean, highly-readable sans for body, UI, data.

rules: Uppercase labels use wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) at small sizes.
Generous line-height for editorial body copy.

layout.style: Editorial: large white space, clean sections, premium spacing (p-8 / p-12 / p-16 / py-24).
layout.grid: Simple, aligned editorial grids. No busy bento or overlapping chaos.

buttons.secondary: White background, emerald border, emerald text.

cards.style: White cards, very subtle shadows, soft #E5E5E5 borders, large padding, rounded corners (radius 0.625rem).

navigation.style: Clean white/near-white sticky header with hairline bottom border. Includes ID/EN language switcher.

icons.usage: Consistent Phosphor icons; thin/regular/duotone weights, emerald or neutral tones.

images.direction: Large premium gemstone photography, bright backgrounds, clean compositions. NO dark overlays.

motion.policy: Restrained. Keep existing subtle hover color transitions only. Do NOT add new animations or grain textures (per locked direction).

instructions_to_main_agent: Light theme only — never apply a `dark` class or theme switching.
Tokens live in src/index.css (:root) and tailwind.config.js. All pages inherit automatically.
Use emerald for primary actions/accents; gold strictly as a sparing secondary accent.
Keep layouts, routing, and pages unchanged unless a sprint explicitly adds them.
Ensure all interactive elements retain data-testid attributes.
